newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends lower, responding to New York.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends lower, responding to New York.

text.p: LIFFE coffee followed New York down, traders said.
By the close active November last traded $26 lower at $1,504, on volume of 1,228 of the total 2,811.
"It's very slow," one trader said. The market was well supported, he said. Technical analysts earlier called the outlook still bearish, but said support at $1,500 on November could hold for now.
A public holiday in much of western Europe kept activity limited, traders said.
New York coffee futures fell sharply ahead of midday on Friday, as speculators sold heavily in anticipation of a rise in U.S. warehouse inventories during July, traders said.
Price falls in Bremen arabicas by $12-20 on the week per 50 kg fob reflected lower futures in New York ahead of expected stocks additions as well as a bear trend in robustas, traders said on Friday.
